# Learned by Heart

> Novels that teach. Each book is a real novel in a popular genre, written so the plot teaches one subject (money, science, history, how the mind works, practical skills) without feeling like a lesson. Chapter one of every library book is free to read online, no sign-up. Readers can also order a novel written for one person, in the style they love, about the thing they have always meant to learn.

- [Home and prices](https://learnedbyheart.com/): how a personal novel works, prices, questions
- [Find a book](https://learnedbyheart.com/find/): pick a genre and a subject, get matching free first chapters
- [Order a personal novel](https://learnedbyheart.com/order.html)

## Money
- [Click Here to Verify](https://learnedbyheart.com/library/click-here-to-verify/): a domestic thriller that teaches scams and fraud, for readers of Freida McFadden
- [Reserve Price](https://learnedbyheart.com/library/reserve-price/): a film-star saga that teaches money across a lifetime, for readers of Taylor Jenkins Reid
- [A Trade in Wind](https://learnedbyheart.com/library/a-trade-in-wind/): a Jazz Age novel that teaches bubbles and crashes, for readers of F. Scott Fitzgerald
- [The Plant Shop in Kyoto](https://learnedbyheart.com/library/the-plant-shop-in-kyoto/): a gentle, cosy novel that teaches running a small business, for readers of Toshikazu Kawaguchi
- [The Pension Heist](https://learnedbyheart.com/library/the-pension-heist/): a caper comedy that teaches pensions and retirement saving, for readers of Janet Evanovich
- [Subject to Survey](https://learnedbyheart.com/library/subject-to-survey/): a haunted-house gothic that teaches buying a home, for readers of Shirley Jackson and T. Kingfisher
- [Inflation, Darling](https://learnedbyheart.com/library/inflation-darling/): a glossy 1970s saga that teaches inflation and how economies work, for readers of Jilly Cooper and Penny Vincenzi
- [The Books Always Balance](https://learnedbyheart.com/library/the-books-always-balance/): a crime family saga that teaches accounting, for readers of Mario Puzo
- [Proof of Reserve](https://learnedbyheart.com/library/proof-of-reserve/): a near-future thriller that teaches what money is, from banks to crypto, for readers of William Gibson and Black Mirror

## Life skills
- [The Knife Table](https://learnedbyheart.com/library/the-knife-table/): a romantasy that teaches negotiation, for readers of Sarah J. Maas and Rebecca Yarros
- [Hackles](https://learnedbyheart.com/library/hackles/): a small-town horror that teaches dog behaviour and training, for readers of Stephen King
- [The Year of the Late Harvest](https://learnedbyheart.com/library/the-year-of-the-late-harvest/): a vineyard family saga that teaches wine, for readers of Liane Moriarty
- [Piano, Piano](https://learnedbyheart.com/library/piano-piano/): a summer romance that teaches beginner Italian, for readers of Beth O’Leary and Jenny Colgan
- [A Very Good Copy](https://learnedbyheart.com/library/a-very-good-copy/): a Regency romance that teaches how to look at a painting, for readers of Julia Quinn and Tessa Dare
- [Initial Here](https://learnedbyheart.com/library/initial-here/): a legal thriller that teaches how the law works for ordinary people, for readers of John Grisham
- [The Wharf Kitchen](https://learnedbyheart.com/library/the-wharf-kitchen/): a small-town romance that teaches how to cook, for readers of Sarah Morgan and Jenny Colgan
- [Re: Your Piano](https://learnedbyheart.com/library/re-your-piano/): a novel in letters that teaches how music works and how to listen, for readers of 84 Charing Cross Road and The Guernsey Literary and Potato Peel Pie Society

## Mind and thinking
- [Turn Towards Me](https://learnedbyheart.com/library/turn-towards-me/): a romantic comedy that teaches the science of relationships, for readers of Emily Henry
- [The Lantern Hour](https://learnedbyheart.com/library/the-lantern-hour/): a dystopian adventure that teaches propaganda and misinformation, for readers of Suzanne Collins
- [The Keeper's Hours](https://learnedbyheart.com/library/the-keepers-hours/): a quiet literary novel that teaches Stoic philosophy for everyday life, for readers of Kazuo Ishiguro
- [Tuesday, Again](https://learnedbyheart.com/library/tuesday-again/): a time-loop thriller that teaches habits and memory, for readers of Blake Crouch
- [The Turned Pillow](https://learnedbyheart.com/library/the-turned-pillow/): a cosy fantasy that teaches sleep, for readers of Travis Baldree
- [The Footbridge](https://learnedbyheart.com/library/the-footbridge/): a dark academia novel that teaches moral philosophy, for readers of Donna Tartt and M.L. Rio
- [A Poisoner Made of Fog](https://learnedbyheart.com/library/a-poisoner-made-of-fog/): a Victorian mystery that teaches cognitive biases and clear thinking, for readers of Arthur Conan Doyle
- [The Other Chair](https://learnedbyheart.com/library/the-other-chair/): a psychological thriller that teaches how the mind works and what therapy does, for readers of Alex Michaelides and Liane Moriarty

## Science and the body
- [Oxygen, Mostly](https://learnedbyheart.com/library/oxygen-mostly/): a funny science survival story that teaches how the body works, for readers of Andy Weir
- [The Hedge-Cook's Daughter](https://learnedbyheart.com/library/the-hedge-cooks-daughter/): a storybook fantasy that teaches everyday chemistry, for readers of J.K. Rowling and J.R.R. Tolkien
- [Water on the Wrong Side](https://learnedbyheart.com/library/water-on-the-wrong-side/): a marshland mystery that teaches wetlands, weather and climate, for readers of Delia Owens
- [Plankton](https://learnedbyheart.com/library/plankton/): a quiet love story that teaches climate science, for readers of Sally Rooney and Claire Keegan
- [Mitochondria, My Love](https://learnedbyheart.com/library/mitochondria-my-love/): a lab romantic comedy that teaches cell biology, for readers of Ali Hazelwood
- [A Brief Affair with the Stars](https://learnedbyheart.com/library/a-brief-affair-with-the-stars/): a sweeping love story that teaches astronomy and space, for readers of Jojo Moyes
- [What the Island Kept](https://learnedbyheart.com/library/what-the-island-kept/): a science thriller that teaches genetics and evolution, for readers of Michael Crichton
- [Reaction Mass](https://learnedbyheart.com/library/reaction-mass/): a space opera that teaches everyday physics, for readers of James S.A. Corey
- [The Cold Store](https://learnedbyheart.com/library/the-cold-store/): a Nordic noir that teaches forensic science, for readers of Jo Nesbø and Ann Cleeves
- [Ladies Who Ruck](https://learnedbyheart.com/library/ladies-who-ruck/): a sports comedy that teaches how muscles grow and what food does, for readers of Ted Lasso and Nick Hornby
- [Notifiable](https://learnedbyheart.com/library/notifiable/): a hospital drama that teaches the immune system, for readers of Adam Kay and Grey's Anatomy
- [Islanding](https://learnedbyheart.com/library/islanding/): a literary novel after the blackout that teaches electricity and energy, for readers of Emily St. John Mandel
- [Noon at Greenwich](https://learnedbyheart.com/library/noon-at-greenwich/): an age-of-sail adventure that teaches navigation and how the oceans move, for readers of Patrick O'Brian
- [Where the Silver Lies](https://learnedbyheart.com/library/where-the-silver-lies/): a Western that teaches geology, for readers of Larry McMurtry and Charles Portis
- [Show Your Working](https://learnedbyheart.com/library/show-your-working/): an epic fantasy that teaches maths: ratio, algebra, geometry and proof, for readers of Brandon Sanderson

## Technology
- [The Chance Machine](https://learnedbyheart.com/library/the-chance-machine/): a gentle what-if story that teaches probability and decisions, for readers of Matt Haig
- [Small Numbers, Big Lies](https://learnedbyheart.com/library/small-numbers-big-lies/): a suburban thriller that teaches statistics and how numbers mislead, for readers of Harlan Coben
- [If, Then, Else](https://learnedbyheart.com/library/if-then-else/): a puzzle mystery that teaches how computers think, for readers of Janice Hallett and Stuart Turton
- [Remember This Device](https://learnedbyheart.com/library/remember-this-device/): a spy thriller that teaches digital privacy and security, for readers of John le Carré and Mick Herron

## History
- [Six Queens' Worth of Thread](https://learnedbyheart.com/library/six-queens-worth-of-thread/): a Tudor court drama that teaches the Tudors, for readers of Philippa Gregory
- [The Cold War in Aunt Rita's Kitchen](https://learnedbyheart.com/library/the-cold-war-in-aunt-ritas-kitchen/): a family saga that teaches the Cold War, start to finish, for readers of Kristin Hannah
- [The Drawing Office](https://learnedbyheart.com/library/the-drawing-office/): a wartime novel that teaches the Second World War, start to finish, for readers of Kate Quinn
- [The Last Honest Senator](https://learnedbyheart.com/library/the-last-honest-senator/): a Roman political thriller that teaches the fall of the Roman Republic, for readers of Robert Harris
- [The Snake King's Daughter](https://learnedbyheart.com/library/the-snake-kings-daughter/): a Greek myth retelling that teaches the ancient Greek world, for readers of Madeline Miller and Jennifer Saint
- [Hacksilver](https://learnedbyheart.com/library/hacksilver/): a Viking saga that teaches the Viking age, for readers of Bernard Cornwell
